headline: Get Puffby
title: How to Get Puffby | Buffby or Royalby | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Puffby is a new Aniimo from Season one Part two, so you need the Whisperwake Isles map. It has no special catch requirement, so any normal Aniipod works. Puffby can evolve into either Buffby or Royalby, and the evolution costs a Hearty Honeybrew. Pick the branch before you spend the item, because you cannot have both from one Puffby. Which one would you choose? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Puffby is a Season 1 Part 2 creature from the Whisperwake Isles. It evolves into Buffby or Royalby using a Hearty Honeybrew.
